source_state: Candidate working tree. Exact-source GitHub Build must bind the final commit and artifact hash before publication.
changes: Choose real resolution per zoom; derive intermediate palette-aware pixels only from complete original fine footprints, without finest-texture minification.
Keep authoritative SavedData v1 unchanged; rebuild derived detail in a bounded transient cache, including isolated locked-map source records.
Use world-anchored 8x8 work, route priority, deferred coverage/budget retries, hand rotation, bounded surface reuse and fair background work.
Preserve pending delivery order across repeated requests and avoid retransmitting unchanged base terrain.
Version owner detail requests as v3 with explicit scale; keep response v2 and the reflected Observer protocol-5 method compatible.
consumer_impact: Nexus-only source edits. Core APIs, Remnant death lifecycle and Discord audit events are unchanged. The Observer relay signature and existing semantic metadata are unchanged; it gets resolution only from a matching validated target request, otherwise coarse fallback. No sibling repository was edited.

full_build.scope_note: Includes the full scheduler integration seam and the final assertion requiring completed footprints during movement at every detail scale.

recording_comparison.fixture: Controlled moving-coordinate route exercising the production sampling worker against real loaded terrain and SavedData, with known base coverage; not a full-player travel timing or FPS benchmark.
recording_comparison.limitations: The old comparison replays candidate selection, not a measured old-build runtime. This does not establish a universal speedup, unloaded-area completion, arbitrary-flight coverage or FPS.

full_scheduler_integration.fixture: Simulated tick-driven integration through the production scheduler, with actual binding/held-map authorization, admission, rotation, shared MapId deduplication and 3 ms scheduling deadline. Not real-player elapsed timing or FPS.
full_scheduler_integration.route: Walk east, sprint south then west; cross a 128-block page boundary. All route footprints remain loaded. Base coverage is pre-established, not measured as sampler output.
full_scheduler_integration.derived_builds: One real 32768-source-read / 2 ms build slice per simulated tick, requested during movement. Every pixel in every visited 8x8 footprint is checked at scales 0, 1, 2 and 3; scale 4 is the known base map.
full_scheduler_integration.limits: Global limits 2048 attempts / 16384 reads, and per-map limits 1024 pending tiles / 1024 deferred cells asserted. Unavailable background cells can saturate deferred capacity; eligible route footprints still completed in this fixture. Completion timing varies with the real deadline and host load.

client_runtime.pixel_assertions: All 20 combinations per runner check exact expected palette RGB for a nested nonuniform pattern, coarse fallback for unknown texels, and exclusion of finer-than-selected submitted layers. Pure reduction tests independently distinguish direct-footprint majority from child-winner majority.
client_runtime.graphics: SDL X11, Xvfb, Vulkan Lavapipe software rendering; no physical-GPU performance claim

observer_e2e.topology: dedicated server + Target JVM + Observer JVM
harness_only_adaptations: localhost binding and existing three-identity fixture whitelist
observer_e2e.prior_interruption: The combined client-plus-E2E invocation exited with SIGTERM (143) before all markers. No failure marker or application crash was found; the termination source was not established. Only E2E was restarted separately in a fresh isolated directory, retaining the interrupted run at /tmp/nexus-0328-observer.Qd1Wrr.

limitations: Recording and caches are bounded. Under saturation, deferred work can wait for a later eligible visit; no cartography chunk tickets are used.
Intermediate colors use deterministic map-palette majority, not vanilla coarse height/water resampling or RGB averaging.
Synthetic-account authentication, headless audio and resize/shutdown warnings occurred in the test environment; they are not evidence of physical-device acceptance.

independent_review.finding: Initial worker-only route validation bypassed admission, rotation and real deadlines.
independent_review.resolution: Added full production tick scheduler integration with eligible held maps, solo/shared holders and competing offhand map, walking/sprinting/turning/page-boundary routes, per-step derived builds and per-scale completion checks. Reviewer verified final during-movement assertion, 120 passing server tests and final JAR SHA512; no remaining implementation blockers. Final runtime, CI and publication gates are tracked separately.

publication_authorization: User explicitly approved implementing the proposal and directly uploading the completed new version to Modrinth.
